entries.title: Hrothgar's Landing
body: A small island off Icecrown's northern coast. There was a tuskarr village here until Drottinn Hrothgar and his kvaldir took it, killing or driving off every one of its people, and named it for himself. Now it is a mist-shrouded staging point from which the sea vrykul strike at the ships of the Silver Covenant and the Sunreavers.

entries.title: The Sea Reaver's Run
body: The strait between the island and Icecrown, where the kvaldir's deepcallers summon krakens against any ship that tries to pass.

entries.title: Drottinn Hrothgar
body: The Sea Reaver, the kvaldir lord who conquered the island and gave it his name.
